meanings: 【名詞】サンドイッチ、パンに具をはさんだ食べ物（food made by placing fillings between slices of bread）
【名詞】複合構造、2つの層の間に材料をはさんだ物（composite structure with something placed between two outer layers）
【動詞】〜の間に挟む、〜を間に挟む（to place something between two other things; to squeeze between）
【動詞】（人や物を）〜の間に閉じ込める（to confine or compress something between two things）
